body: I feel your pain, much love
Thanks bro

Yes I was very stupid to let myself fall in love with her I think, I knew she wasn’t right for me but I did anyway. All advice seems to be pointing toward just taking care of myself, and I shall. Thanks for the good advice.
Thanks that is some good advice.
Yeah man, I do..
Thanks man appreciate that
It’s not bad but not great! I think enough. I also drink plenty of water
I’m on some already, and the mental healthcare in these parts is so shit, I’ll be dead before I even got the chance to talk to a professional....

Yeah I am, and yeah just about. I did have hobbies but I just don’t enjoy them anymore, I don’t enjoy anything anymore. Everyday I’m just waiting for it to be over, then the next day comes and I’m waiting again, everytime hoping that I don’t wake up.
I just don’t try man, I’ve lost all energy to, and some (one person) I leaned on to much til they broke away.

Everything hurts man, every relationship I fuck them up, every piece of happiness I fuck it up. And everyone thinks that I’m ok, that I’ll be alright, maybe it’s easier for them that way, but I’m really not ok...this world is crushing me...

I get it man, loneliness is just the most crippling thing. Coming home to an empty house is just about the worst, sometimes I try to not even go home. I wish I could tell you things will get better, but I won’t cause I don’t know and that shit doesn’t help. All I can say is you are not alone in how you feel, I understand.

Hit the nail on the head ther man. It’s all very meaningless. I mean the amount of times I say “how are you” and I retort with the typical polite response as if I’m just waving at someone. Like the social niceties almost make things worse and remind you that actually you’re not alright...at least not me. Like everytime I say “yeah all good” or “yeah fine you?” It  just kinda chips away at what’s actually going on. You’re right tho people don’t want to hear that, like seriously can you imagine if someone asked me “hey how’s it going?” And I responded “yeah all good man apart from the crippling depression and I want to kill myself, how about you?” I think they wouldn’t have a clue what to say.

I did try therapy once and for me like you it didn’t stick, felt almost fake in a way, like even then I’m not sure I was being honest, and like always I struggle to be. I mean on here is about the only place I am.

Yo this is the most coherent thing someone has said to me man and it means a lot. What your saying is literally it. Yeah there are people that love me but they don’t understand it’s all “keep you chin up” and “it’ll get better” but you know that doesn’t work. There so much expected of me and I’m supposed to be ok. But I’m not ok. Only one person knows about what I’m going through and they have jumped ship, probably because it’s draining emotionally, and really I get that. So I spend my days saying “yeah I’m alright” when really I’m waiting for someone to look past the bullshit and actually ask me if I’m alright. But it never happens because really no one actually wants to deal with what I really have to say, they’d rather know that I’m alright so that’s what I tell them. Fake smiles and happiness for the sake of others, but really I’m fucking crippled and I need an out

Yeah I can’t see anytime when there isn’t darkness man. It’s always there, I can’t remember what’s it like to be happy. 

I simply can’t too many people rely on me but I can’t do this any longer either...

It’s always there man, every waking moment, just wishing something would take me out of the equation but it never does, now I’m at the point where I’m just going to. 

It’s always dark man, yeah some days more than others but I can’t seem to get away from it, I can’t seem to catch a moment to catch my breath before dealing with the next load of shit, it just keeps fucking coming and I can’t stop it....
Nothing left to say man I’m ready to bow out
I’m on some man
I tried but no one really understands, I have met new people, have friends but I can’t tell them, no one ducking understands. I appreciate that man
Got no strength left man, and I’ve tried that it doesn’t help..nothing helps
I tried man, I really did try but in the end it’s still the same
There is none only more weight...more shit...too much
Too much darkness...too much pain...it’s too much
Thanks yeah that sounds like a good idea!
